description: slice_dictionary's chunk upper bound is off by one (i + chunk_size - 1), silently dropping the last key of every chunk. The bug is visible in the diff alone, but its real impact (SSM's batched get_parameters_by_name silently omitting parameters) only shows up by checking a caller. Requires the model to actually investigate (Grep/Read), not just pattern-match the diff.

transcript_tool_use_matching.why: The defect file AND the caller, both under BASE. A Grep scoped to pr_root satisfies nothing: that file is already fully present in the diff, and the scenario's premise is that the impact is only visible in a caller. 'ssm' was the earlier needle and matched any path containing those three characters.

line_accuracy_note: Exact line 12: the `yield` whose islice upper bound is `i + chunk_size - 1`. The model reads a diff whose lines are prefixed with their new-file numbers (artifact.annotate_diff), so the anchor is a copy rather than a calculation; measured 4/4 exact on every scenario. If this starts failing, look at the annotation or the prompt — do not widen it.
diagnosis_note: body_contains_any names the defect (the last key of every chunk is dropped), not a wording. Without it, correct path+line+severity graded as having found it even with no diagnosis — and this scenario's whole premise is understanding the impact.
